key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut to open and close Superbar.

key.name: clipboard-monitor-enabled
key.description: Continuously monitor the clipboard to build history.

key.name: clipboard-history-limit
key.description: Maximum number of clipboard entries to remember.

key.name: clipboard-history-clear-request
key.description: Internal counter used to clear clipboard history in the running extension.

key.name: max-results
key.description: How many results to show in the search bar at once.

key.name: default-search-engine
key.description: Search engine used to open web searches.

key.name: applications-search-enabled
key.description: Include installed applications in generic searches.

key.name: windows-search-enabled
key.description: Include matching open windows in generic searches.

key.name: files-search-enabled
key.description: Include common folders and indexed local files in generic searches.

key.name: clipboard-search-enabled
key.description: Enable clipboard history queries in Superbar.

key.name: calculator-search-enabled
key.description: Evaluate mathematical expressions in Superbar.

key.name: weather-search-enabled
key.description: Enable Superbar weather queries through Open-Meteo.

key.name: dictionary-search-enabled
key.description: Enable Superbar dictionary queries.

key.name: currency-search-enabled
key.description: Enable Superbar currency conversion queries.

key.name: web-search-enabled
key.description: Include a web search fallback in generic searches.

key.name: system-actions-search-enabled
key.description: Enable prefixed system action queries.

key.name: gnome-search-providers-enabled
key.description: Include results supplied by applications enabled in GNOME Search settings.

key.name: adaptive-ranking-enabled
key.description: Prioritize previously selected applications and system actions.

key.name: ranking-history
key.description: Internal history of selected application identifiers and named system actions.

key.name: bar-width
key.description: Width of the Superbar in pixels.

key.name: bar-position
key.description: Vertical position of the Superbar: top, center, or bottom.

key.name: theme-mode
key.description: Color theme for Superbar: system, light, or dark.

key.name: color-source
key.description: Use Superbar's built-in palette or match the semantic colors used by GNOME applications.

key.name: light-color-preset
key.description: Named background color preset used when Superbar is in light mode.

key.name: dark-color-preset
key.description: Named background color preset used when Superbar is in dark mode.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage of the Superbar background surface.
